sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 is a native multimodal foundation model family that combines text and vision capabilities within a unified architecture. It is designed to improve performance across a broad set of tasks, including reasoning, coding, agent workflows, and visual understanding, while also emphasizing efficient inference and scalable deployment.
